title: give: the request
description: Gives one part to a member: the client builds the message, mints its id and salt, and signs the envelope at the key's next seq. Returns the receipt; when the part is asked about, the question's id, at once.

to.description: The receiver: a member's actor reference.

data.description: The body, as any JSON value.

re.description: What the part is about, such as a question's id.
